कैरविणी [kairaviṇī], 1 A lotus plant bearing white lotuses.
A place (pond &c.) abounding in white lotuses
An assemblage of white lotuses; इन्दुर्विकासयति कैर- विणीकुलानि
कैराटकः [kairāṭakḥ], A kind of vegetable poison.
कैरात [kairāta], a. [किरात-अण्] Belonging to the Kirātas.
तः A prince of the Kirātas.
A strong man. -तम् A kind of sandal-wood.
कैरात [kairāta] ति [ti] क [k], (ति) क a. Belonging to the Kirātas; कैरातकी- नामयुतं दासीनां च विशांपते (आहृत्य)
